description: One evening David asked his agent team for a fantasy pinball game. This is how they built it: who did what, how they handled three rounds of his feedback, where the time went (about twenty-nine agent hours; about ten to fifteen minutes of David's), and why we ran it on Directive: so he can be more of a Human Being and less of a Human Doing. The narrator's voice is synthetic; every frame of gameplay is the real game. Play it free: https://directivedemos.github.io/pinball/ .
